text:
Lena (People Ops): quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A thread 10 mins left: we promised a short FAQ covering: promo windows, retro pay, equity refresh timing, and benefits enrollment questions. dropping it here so folks can react.

Marco (VP Eng): thanks! can we confirm whether equity refresh conversations are tied to promo cycles or handled separately?

Riley (Manager): also — new managers keep asking: if someone was promoted externally before our cycle, do we run them through calibration or treat as special case?

Diego (Finance): short answers from finance side: equity refresh is decoupled from title changes. refresh recommendations happen twice a year (mid-year & year-end) and are reviewed by Finance + People Ops during calibration windows.

Ari (People Ops): for external hires who received an immediate title bump at offer: treat as special case. fill out the "hire-adjust" section in the promo form and tag your recruiting partner + People Ops. we will fast-track review but still need approvals.

Lena (People Ops): TL;DR timeline:
 - self-reviews close: 2026-06-04 EOD PT
 - manager review window: 2026-06-07 -> 2026-06-14
 - calibration meeting block: 2026-06-15 -> 2026-06-18
 - retro/appeals window open: 2026-06-19 -> 2026-06-25

Riley (Manager): great, any hard budget limits we should flag before we submit 1:1 recs?

Diego (Finance): budget notes: overall comp pool targets were shared in the all-hands slide deck. practical rules:
 - merit: up to 5% manager-approved without Finance signoff
 - >5% base increase or signficant band move: requires Director + Finance + People Ops
 - off-cycle promos that add >10% headcount cost to an org need Exec approval

Lena (People Ops): on appeals/retro: if an admin error prevented someone from being included (bad form, missed signoff), file the retro form and include the original manager notes + evidence. Payroll will process retro on the next run after approval (expect ~2 pay cycles).

BenefitsBot: FYI: 401k match and open enrollment dates unchanged. Open enrollment runs 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-14. Match policy unchanged for CY2026.

Riley (Manager): template request: can People Ops post a short manager justification template we can paste into docs? saves time.

Ari (People Ops): yes. paste this into the promo form or your manager note field: 

```
Candidate: <Full name>\nCurrent title/band: <title>\nRequested title/band: <title>\nPrimary rationale (3 bullets):\n - measurable impact (metrics if possible)\n - new scope / cross-team leadership\n - market/retention signal\nManager assessment (2 sentences):\n - readiness summary + where role changes land vs band midpoints\nRequested compensation action: <none / merit % / band move>\nAttachments: link to PRs, project summary, customer feedback\nApprovals needed: Manager / Director / People Ops / Finance (if >5%)
```

Marco (VP Eng): helpful. can we also get a short script for how to communicate a denied promo to ICs? want to keep messaging consistent.

Lena (People Ops): short script: "we appreciate your contributions and the calibration group reviewed your case. while we aren't moving you this cycle, here are 3 concrete milestones we'll use to re-evaluate in the next cycle: <milestone 1>, <milestone 2>, <milestone 3>. we'll support with a development plan and quarterly check-ins."

Riley (Manager): thanks — that wording is perfect.

Diego (Finance): one more: if a promotion includes an equity refresh, value of refresh will be modeled at the time of grant and treated as separate approval item. include requested budget line in the promo form so Finance can pre-check.

Ari (People Ops): meta: we'll post the full FAQ + form links in #people-ops-resources after this thread. office hours tomorrow 3pm PT for drop-in 1:1s (30m slots). sign up: https://intra.redwood.company/officehours/peopleops.

OpsBot: Reminder set: Office hours - People Ops calibration Q&A (2026-05-18 15:00 PT).

Lena (People Ops): last note: fairness guardrail = aim for <6% off-cycle promos in any single org. we reserve the right to decline off-cycle exceptions when it would materially skew calibration fairness. DM Ari or me for escalations.

Riley (Manager): perfect, sharing with my leads. thanks everyone. :heart: 

Marco (VP Eng): big thanks to People Ops for the clarity and templates. helps a ton.

Ari (People Ops): thanks all. well update the resources doc and tweet the cheatsheet internally. please react with :thumbsup: if this thread answered your questions.
